records.comment: Naruto is the protagonist and title character. Showing a clear image of him and asking for his name is trivial and must not appear again. Naruto may still appear in scene, event, action, ability, dialogue, sequence, or visual-observation questions.

records.question: من هو الزعيم الحقيقي لمنظمة أكاتسكي الذي يتحكم بجميع أعضائها؟
